comment: Shared vectors for the oklch -> sRGB conversion mermaid needs.
TWO implementations run these: panel/src/app/color.js (the remote
panel, a separate Vite app) and src/sections/config/mermaidColor.ts
(the Tauri renderer). They cannot import each other, so this file is
the pin — the same arrangement PriceBook/costs.ts and session::title
already use. Change one implementation, change the other, add a vector.
Expectations are CSS Color 4 oklch -> sRGB, gamma-encoded and
quantised to 8 bits. Alpha below 1 renders as rgba(); anything that is
not an oklch() string passes through untouched, because khroma already
